apparatus.note: The original 1901 printed marginal apparatus notes: “Many ancient authorities read lawlessness.”
The printed apparatus includes manuscript variation about the presence of “Jesus” and the rendering “consume.” The historical facsimile retains the full note.

scope_note: Selected major original 1901 marginal notes, supplemented by all original scanned printed apparatus and byte-preserved original digital USX notes; not a modern textual-critical reconstruction.
